U1: developer wants similar approach to creating reactor based stream processor as with Spark and RxJava. A plugin should allow a reactor processor module to specify bare minimum (processor class). Explore how additional config can be achieved with well known module option commands.
U2: upgrade to Reactor 2.0 RC1 release to synchronize with stable dependencies.
U3: user wants Redis based aggregation over field-value counters, continuously write aggregation in Redis as ingest more data. Scope: Port specs from previous implementation (link). Identify gaps. Update reference documentation.
U4: same as U3? Actually U4 is duplicate of U3 but says "Redis based aggregation over field-value counters" (same). It's likely a duplicate; maybe U3 and U4 are identical (maybe one is typo). We can treat as one requirement or two? The spec lists U3 and U4 separately but they are essentially the same. We should handle as one activity or note duplication. Since they are identical, we can assume it's a duplicate and we implement once. But to be safe, we can combine into one activity "Implement Redis based aggregation over field-value counters" covering port specs, identify gaps, update docs. Or we can treat them as same requirement, no extra effort for duplicate. We'll note assumption: U3 and U4 are duplicates, will be implemented once.
U5: developer wants to isolate Hadoop tests in a different project so DIRT project doesn't have to depend upon, eliminating incorrect CP file generation in eclipse.
U6: developer wants acceptance test coverage for XD + YARN on EC2 to verify simple XD features running on YARN on every build cycle.
U7: user wants to use RxJava based processor module to leverage RxJava APIs for data computations.
U8: user wants option to extend default message handling behavior for HTTP source-module to override settings via servers.yml to control default message size. Currently hard-coded 1MB limit in HttpChunkAggregator. Expose property for overrides.

Also note U1 mentions reactor based stream processor plugin, similar to Spark and RxJava. U7 is RxJava based processor module. U1 is reactor based stream processor (maybe Project Reactor? Reactor 2.0 RC1 in U2). So we have reactor processor plugin, RxJava processor module, upgrade Reactor 2.0 RC1, Redis aggregation, Hadoop test isolation, YARN on EC2 acceptance tests, HTTP source message size config.
